tools.name: audit_store
tools.description: Audit a Shopify store's listing photos (no account needed). Scans the public product sitemap for stale photos (≥180 days), season mismatches (e.g. winter items with summer-shot photos), and upcoming retail-calendar windows. Returns work orders with pre-filled create_tryon_job fixes and estimated credit costs.

store_url.description: Store domain or URL, e.g. examplestore.com

tools.name: get_seasonal_guide
tools.description: Retail shoot calendar for fashion sellers (no account needed): which shoot windows (Labor Day, Halloween, Fall/Winter drop, Black Friday, Holiday) are open or urgent right now, deadlines, and links to per-category shoot guides with recommended shots.

category.description: Optional: limit guide links to one category

tools.name: create_preview_job
tools.description: ONE free on-model preview per store, no account needed. Pass the store and one of its listing photo URLs (from an audit_store work order) to generate a free 2K on-model try-on photo — the taste before buying credits. Poll with get_preview_status.

store_url.description: The store the photo belongs to (same as audit_store)

garment_image_url.description: A listing photo URL from that store (audit work order image_url)

tools.name: get_preview_status
tools.description: Poll a free preview. When succeeded, returns the preview image URL (valid 1h). No account needed.

tools.name: create_tryon_job
tools.description: Generate an on-model try-on photo from a garment/product image URL (e.g. straight from an audit_store work order). Charges 1 credit (2K) or 2 credits (4K) from the account's studio credits. Requires an API key.

garment_image_url.description: Public URL of the garment/product photo

model_image_url.description: Optional: custom model reference photo URL

api_key.description: API key if the client can't send an Authorization header

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Poll a generation job. When succeeded, returns presigned output image URLs (valid 1h). Requires an API key.

api_key.description: API key if the client can't send an Authorization header

tools.name: get_credits_balance
tools.description: Studio credit balance and top-up link. Requires an API key.

api_key.description: API key if the client can't send an Authorization header
